preconditions: An API reflects the Origin header into Access-Control-Allow-Origin and also sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true

process.action: Send a request with an arbitrary Origin header to a sensitive, credentialed API endpoint
process.expected_observation: Response reflects the arbitrary Origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin

process.action: Check whether Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true is also set alongside the reflected origin
process.expected_observation: Both headers present together, enabling credentialed cross-origin reads

process.action: Build a PoC page hosted on an attacker-controlled origin that fetches the sensitive endpoint with credentials included

process.action: Test null-origin and subdomain wildcard handling for additional bypass paths

impact: Cross-origin theft of authenticated API responses, including PII and session-adjacent data
